purpose: Source-first cross-border investigation. No automatic attribution, criminal inferences or publication approvals.
regionalMode: Other countries grouped by geographic region unless a verified case warrants country-specific analysis

sourceRecord.sourceId: official authority or explicitly labeled aggregator
sourceRecord.rawSHA256: digest of exact retrieved bytes when processed

entity.names: sourced aliases with dates and language
entity.identifiers: namespace and exact value, restricted fields masked

edge.assessmentScore: only for a hypothesis; not asserted truth

hardKeys: ICAO24 + observation date (address, not legal ownership)
identityResolution.rule: Never turn a soft match into confirmed identity without corroboration. Don't treat IP addresses or ICAO24 as permanent ownership identifiers.
joinGuidance: UK Companies House company number + jurisdiction GB -> supplier organization in FTS OCDS only with matching registered identifiers
PSC → legal entity is reported control, not automatically actual beneficial ownership or illicit activity
EU TED OCID and UK FTS OCID are procurement references, not proof of a multinational parent entity
ECLI/court docket links are procedural records; outcomes and appeal statuses must be checked
ICAO24 transponder data and IMO vessel IDs are observations/identifiers, not attribution to an owner or sponsor

publicationGates: No automatic publishing from feed ingestion
Separate allegations, findings, sanctions and debarments
All provenance and licensing attached to normalized records
Peer and time corroboration before cross-list attribution
Mask sensitive personal identifiers in public views
Keep EU/UK/US/UN regimes separate rather than treating as interchangeable
Record missing, withdrawn and superseded entries
priorityWorkflows: sanctions evasion: sanctions → ownership → procurement → maritime/aviation observations
foreign influence: registry → lobbying disclosures → contracts → legal outcomes
resource security: concessions → beneficiaries → trade flows → regional conflict
corruption: debarment → contracts → ownership → court disposition

implementation.otherSources: indexed for access review; not yet connected
implementation.archiveCapture: not yet configured for bulk WARC
implementation.status: registry and on-demand public source search
implementation.internationalExpansion: United Kingdom Companies House and PSC, Find a Tender OCDS, UK Gazette, CJEU case law indexed alongside existing EU/Five Eyes; bulk feeds not claimed active

ukSanctionsReconciliation.historicSource: UK HM Treasury OFSI Consolidated List frozen 2026-01-28
ukSanctionsReconciliation.statusAuthority: Current UKSL only; archived OFSI records may not establish currently active designation
ukSanctionsReconciliation.hardJoin: OFSI Group ID in UKSL equal to historical OFSI Group ID, and only when both records present
ukSanctionsReconciliation.weakJoin: Name or alias equality = possible match requiring manual review, never auto-merge
ukSanctionsReconciliation.historicOnly: Legacy archived match absent from current list remains historical_only_unconfirmed_current (not active)
ukSanctionsReconciliation.noLegacyResponse: Archive unavailable means reconciliation incomplete; never assert no historical match
ukSanctionsReconciliation.provenance: Preserve both source URLs, timestamp, SHA-256 when source retrieved and user-visible as-of/status

ukProcurement.caveat: Not exhaustive; keywords only filter the returned batch; no automatic entity resolution or published investigation claims
